name: Aurora Bell Sanctuary
core_rationale: Central resonant starlight-bell sanctuary of Aurora Chime Atoll at [1, 1] where sky-acousticians tune the crystal stalactite chimes above the Stalactite Carillon Nave.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Luminous violet-green aurora pools that ripple in sympathy with the hanging crystal bells

North.lock_message: Charged solar-wind curtains across Magnetosphere Ribbon Arch repel unshielded gliders; Chime-Keeper Aether requires the Stalactite Bell-Clapper before opening the northern arch.

resident_npcs.name: Chime-Keeper Aether
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Aurora Bell Sanctuary! Touch the tuning forks on my 0.58 meter basalt desk and feel the aurora sing through the stone.

resident_npcs.name: Bell-Carver Cyra
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Stalactite Carillon Nave, a resonant seraph-choir guards the Stalactite Bell-Clapper needed to cross Magnetosphere Ribbon Arch!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Aurora Chime Atoll at [1, 1] directly above Vesper's Stalactite Carillon Nave.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Floating basalt plaza crowned by luminous crystal stalactite bells beneath violet-green aurora ribbons.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m tuning desks, 0.14m basalt risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Magnetosphere Ribbon Arch behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
